claims.text: Role in enuresis: behavioral modification = first-line;
claims.quote: Behavioral modifications should be first-line recommendations for patients with enuresis.

claims.text: a bed-wetting alarm = the most effective long-term strategy w no organic cause;
claims.quote: The most effective long-term strategy, when no organic causes are present, is a bed-wetting alarm.

claims.text: oral desmopressin (or imipramine) can ↓ nighttime wetting, but results aren't sustained in most pts after stopping;
claims.quote: Medications such as oral desmopressin (DDAVP, arginine vasopressin) and imipramine (see table Some Oral Medications Used for Urinary Incontinence in Children) can decrease nighttime wetting episodes. However, results are not sustained in most patients when the treatment is stopped

claims.text: DDAVP is preferable to imipramine (rare sudden death w imipramine).
claims.quote: DDAVP is preferable to imipramine because of the rare possibility of sudden death with imipramine use.

claims.text: Boxed warning: severe hyponatremia can cause seizures, coma, resp arrest or death.
claims.quote: DDAVP can cause hyponatremia. Severe hyponatremia can be life-threatening, leading to seizures, coma, respiratory arrest, or death

claims.text: CI: ↑risk of severe hyponatremia, eg, excessive fluid intake, fluid/electrolyte-disturbing illness, loop diuretics, systemic or inhaled glucocorticoids.
claims.quote: DDAVP is contraindicated in patients at increased risk of severe hyponatremia, such as patients with excessive fluid intake, illnesses that can cause fluid or electrolyte imbalances, and in those using loop diuretics or systemic or inhaled glucocorticoids

claims.text: Sodium must be norm b4 starting; recheck w.in 7 days and about 1 mo after starting, then periodically.
claims.quote: Ensure the serum sodium concentration is normal before starting or resuming DDAVP. Measure serum sodium within 7 days and approximately 1 month after initiating therapy, and periodically during treatment.
For All Patients Receiving Repeated Doses: Restrict free water intake and monitor for hyponatremia.
